title: Half of PH health spending went to chronic diseases in 2025

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Noncommunicable diseases (NCDs), including heart disease, diabetes and cancer, accounted for more than half of the Philippines’ health expenditures in 2025, while spending on medicines and medical supplies also increased, highlighting the growing financial demands of managing chronic illnesses. Data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), analyzed by University of the Philippines
